## Summary

Describe the smallest complete change and why it is needed.

## Foundation boundary

- [ ] This change belongs in a product-agnostic AI foundation.
- [ ] It does not introduce 0x1, Prism, or other product-specific semantics into shared AI contracts.

## Verification

Describe tests, evaluations, provider/runtime checks, contract checks, or manual verification performed.

## Licensing and contribution rights

- [ ] New authored source/config files carry the canonical copyright header and `SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0` where the format supports comments.
- [ ] Third-party code, models, datasets, generated material, and required notices are identified and preserved.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution and have read `CLA.md`; I understand maintainers may require explicit CLA acceptance before an external contribution is merged.

## Compatibility / security

- [ ] I documented any compatibility, migration, security, privacy, model/provider, or licensing impact, or none applies.
